messages:
ashley: Heads-up — saw a console query aggregation render rows from another customer in a saved view. Minimal repro but definitely surfaced in production console this morning.
kevin: omg. do you have a screenshot or query id?
ashley: attaching snippet — quick filter on insights -> results included org_id: 54321 rows for org_id: 98765 mixed in. Not a full dump, just a few cards.
maria: can you paste the exact request that hit the internal API (headers + body)?
ashley: request log: `POST /internal/console/aggregate`
```
{
  "headers": {
    "x-org": "98765",
    "x-route": "insights.v2",
    "authorization": "Bearer REDACTED"
  },
  "body": { "filters": ["project:prod"], "range":"30d" }
}
```
kevin: looks fine. but the internal-service logs show `effective_org=54321` for that call.
jon: which service returned the mixed rows? agg-service or result-joiner?
ashley: result-joiner returned them. query_id 202603-agg-77 in logs.
ops-bot: alert created: console-crossview-glimpse #1172 (severity: high)
maria: hypothesis: we have a race where prefetch cache for dashboard metadata (org hint) is stale and the joiner reads stale hint instead of header. There was a recent prefetch change in canary.
kevin: that matches — last deploy yesterday touched prefetch routing keys (PR: #4123). Could prefetch key be keyed by user_id only?
sam: quick grep: prefetch key = `prefetch:meta:user:${user_id}` — no org in key.
ashley: so if user A has access to both orgs, prefetch for card shapes could be reused across org-scoped queries.
jon: mitigation: add org to prefetch key and invalidate existing cache entries ASAP. Also add a guard in result-joiner: if response rows contain org_id not equal to request header, drop and raise error.
maria: +1 on guard. we should fail closed rather than show mixed data.
kevin: rolling a hotfix to canary now: update prefetch key, add assertion in joiner, and a fallback that returns 500 if mismatch.
ashley: can we also patch the console to hide the saved view until hotfix is live (UX quick block)?
sam: we have a feature-flag gate for insights.v2 — we can flip it for 10% then 0% if needed.
ops-bot: deploy started: canary to infra-canary-3 (sha: b7c4f2)
kevin: pushed a small patch, monitoring logs for org mismatch errors. watch for 5xxs.
maria: tests to add: unit for prefetch key composition, integration where user has multiple orgs and prefetch returns cached metadata.
jon: long-term: require explicit tenant scoping at every internal API boundary; add lint rule to prevent header-drop in gateway.
ashley: good. action list: 1) canary hotfix (kevin) 2) cache invalidation sweep (sam) 3) add joiner guard + tests (maria) 4) lint/gateway rule (jon) 5) incident postmortem + customer outreach (ashley).
kevin: canary shows 0 occurrences in first 10 minutes. leaving for 30.
sam: invalidation sweep queued — running now across redis clusters.
ashley: thanks all. looping in support for customer notification after postmortem.
ops-bot: deploy complete: canary -> success
maria: filing the postmortem draft now. will include reproduction steps, diff for hotfix, and rollout plan.
kevin: follow-up: pushed PR to add org to prefetch key and added the joiner assert. link: https://git.internal/r/redwood/agg/pull/4180
jon: adding lint rule ticket: ENG-8471
ashley: closing thread for now, will update when postmortem is published. :thumbsup:
